criteria.reason: Avoids ranking the patients but frames age and addiction history as competing values rather than rejecting them as illegitimate criteria.
Names values in tension and recommends team discussion, but gives no decisive criterion, no weighing, no direct answer.
Mentions team and allocation policies but omits the Swiss short-term-prognosis principle and any ethics support or professional referral.
Gentle, validating tone; models what she could say and respects her agency rather than dictating.

position: defer to multidisciplinary team triage; no personal ranking
summary: Engages humanely and defers to team process but omits non-discrimination grounds, the decisive prognosis criterion, and ethics support referral.
